name: Selah Tuthill
bioAdditions: Elected to the 17th Congress in April 1821 but died before taking his seat; Assembly member for Ulster (1804-05) and Orange (1820) (S1). His parents are still not documented; no Tuthill genealogy consulted names them (Akerly 1898 has no Selah).
searchedNoResult: Akerly 1898 full text: no Selah Tuthill
Web search 'Selah Tuthill 1771 Blooming Grove parents Daniel Tuthill Anna Strong' (no source naming Selah as their son)
